notes.title: Nolgorb's new year patch!
notes.content:
Assemble nolgbros! the game has been worked on a little bit by the developer, some changes are good some are probably not, like the new achievements you can achieve!
and some figurines for you to collect. and more!

and now your savefile will unfortunately be reset,
but lets be honest all of you are still stuck on the bottom

notes.title: Controller support is here on September 25th.
notes.content: You can select Xbox or Playstation icons in the menu. Thanks for playing.

notes.title: Patch 0.2
notes.content:
The volume buttons in the options menu finally affect the volume of the game.
Getting stuck in the options menu should now reset Nolgorb after 10 seconds.

notes.title: Patch 0.1
notes.content: Fixed the toy pickup message. Thanks for playing.
